An AI session builds real Windmill items: scripts, flows, apps, AI agents and data pipelines. Each one is code you can read, and each one runs.
Ask for the whole job in one message.
First, the script. Windmill runs scripts in more than twenty languages, from TypeScript and Python to Go, SQL and Bash.
Here it's TypeScript: a main function, with the Stripe connection passed in as a typed resource.
Then the flow. Its graph shows each step, and each step points at a script. Open its code, and it's a YAML definition you can review or edit.
The schedule is a cron expression, and the flow it runs.
The app is a React project. Its preview runs live, next to the chat: the support team can already search the refunds.
Everything lands as a draft: saved on the server, visible only to you, and never run in production.
To test the flow, click Run. The open editor runs your draft: each step lights up as a worker executes it, and the result comes back in the chat.
The same session builds AI agents: a flow step that calls a model, with your own scripts as its tools.
And data pipelines, in alpha: scripts in one folder, chained by the data they read and write.
With AI sessions, you can build any internal software, and keep all of it in one workspace.
